verdict.rationale: Cactus positions itself as a platform for automation-oriented models: tool-calling models, fine-tuning and on-device inference. Asking whether users can version, review and roll back their automations is therefore a fair question. The evidence pack documents no way to version automation definitions, review their changes, or roll them back. The only related item is pinning `generation=2` to keep running Needle 2, which is model version selection, an adjacent feature rather than automation versioning or rollback, so it earns no credit.
